dealSummary: Israeli semiconductor startup Xsight Labs raised over $300 million at a $2.8 billion valuation in a round led by Fidelity Management & Research Company.
Los Angeles-based Whatnot, a livestream shopping startup, is in talks to raise a new round at about a $20 billion valuation, Business Insider reported.

Ratio Therapeutics, a Boston-based developer of radiopharmaceuticals for cancer treatment, raised a $70 million Series C from investors including Duquesne Family Office, Bristol Myers Squibb and Catalio Capital Management.
leadInvestors: Duquesne Family Office, Bristol Myers Squibb, Catalio Capital Management

dealSummary: London-based physical AI startup PhysicsX raised $25 million from the British Business Bank as part of its $300 million Series C.
New York-based Dili, a developer of AI compliance software for infrastructure and construction projects, raised a $15 million Series A led by Khosla Ventures.
Balance Theory, a developer of an AI-native platform for cybersecurity investment decisions, raised a $19 million Series A led by SYN Ventures.
Burlington, Vermont-based The Farmer Companies, which houses brands like Whisps and Cabot Creamery, raised a $17 million Series A led by Raff Ventures.
Smallest AI, a developer of real-time voice AI models, raised a $13 million Series A led by Seligman Ventures.
Discern Security, a developer of AI agents that help close gaps in companies’ existing security tools, raised a $13 million Series A led by Forgepoint Capital.
